Accepted as version 1: 11 layer(s).
Quick check of version 1 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Reviewed filmstrip (rows: target / yours).

1. Panel body — 0.80–5.96s — yours never draws the card at all; only a ~2px colored sliver at the cell bottom (canvas y ≈ 218–230) — target grows a dark navy rounded rect from ~0.80s, full size by 1.20s, ≈ x 30–225 / y 55–210, held to the end.
2. Window chrome — 1.20–2.36s — yours has no dots and no title bar — target pops 2→3 control dots at the card's top-left (≈ x 40–70 / y 62–68) at 1.20/1.56s, then grows a white title bar (x ≈ 45→180 / y ≈ 95) at 1.96–2.36s.
3. Content bars — 2.36–5.96s — yours keeps every bar as a 1–2px sliver at y ≈ 218–225 and never stacks upward; green/teal rows are missing — target places red+blue bars at y ≈ 135–150 by 2.76s, then fills green/teal rows upward to y ≈ 70–150 by 4.36s (6–8 bars by 5.92s).
4. Minor: 0.40s gray ghost is present in both, but in yours it stays a flat light rect (≈ x 90–225 / y 55–130) while the target hands off to the dark panel at 0.80s.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 2: 12 layer(s).
Quick check of version 2 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
CHANGE: better — "yours" restores the dark card, white title bar and red/green/teal bar stack that "previous" never drew (it only had the dots and floating bars); nothing got worse.

1. Card grow-in, 0.40–1.20s: at 0.80s yours is just a ~10 px dark sliver at the bottom of the card area (≈x30–225, y≈205–225) and then snaps to full height by 1.20s; the target grows the card smoothly from the bottom edge (top ≈y150 at 0.80s → ≈y120 at 1.20s → ≈y25 by 1.56s).
2. Three-dot menu, 1.20–1.56s: yours fades the dots in already at ≈1.20s (≈x50, y55); the target keeps the card clean at 1.20s and only fades the dots in around 1.5–1.9s.
3. Bar widths, 3.16–5.92s: yours' green/teal bars are already near their final lengths at 3.16s (teal ≈x95–185) and then barely move; the target keeps extending them through ≈5.5s (teal ≈x95–140 at 3.16s → ≈x95–215 at 5.92s).
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 3: 13 layer(s).
Quick check of version 3 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is further from the target than "previous": the 0.40 s placeholder now has the right size/inset (that got better), but the card fill at 1.20 s and the first content lines at 2.76 s got worse. CHANGE: worse

- Window card, 0.72–1.30 s: target is already a solid dark navy panel with its three window dots by 0.80 s; yours is still a light-grey panel with a grey bar along the bottom at 0.80 s, and at 1.20 s only the upper part (y≈30–135) is dark — the fill lands ~0.4 s late and non-uniformly. Target: uniformly dark card from 0.80 s on.
- Blue content line, 2.36–3.16 s: target grows a blue bar at y≈112 from x≈62 out to x≈165 by 2.76 s; yours at 2.76 s shows only a stub red line plus a stray green tick at x≈62, y≈100, with no blue bar until ≈3.16 s.
- Content lines, 3.16–3.96 s: target already has 4 bars under the white title bar at 3.16 s and 5 by 3.96 s; yours carries one fewer bar across that window, so the block fills ~0.4 s behind.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 4: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 4 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer to the target than previous: the card now goes dark and scales to full size by 1.20s, whereas previous was still pale gray at 0.80s with a stray gray line at y≈130, so the early build-in is fixed. CHANGE: better

1. Skeleton rows appear too early — 1.96s–2.76s: at 2.36s yours already draws three colored rows (red/blue/teal, y≈95–120) under the white bar, while target draws only two (red x 60–130, blue x 60–130); at 2.76s yours has four rows vs target's three. Target adds one row per ~0.4s and finishes ~4.0s.
2. Fade-in ghost geometry — 0.40s: target's pale card is large and high (≈ x 40–215, y 15–150); yours is small and low (≈ x 75–180, y 55–155), so yours grows in from the old size/position instead of a near-full-size ghost.
3. Stray white square — 1.96s: yours shows a small white square at the card's top-left (≈ x 62–72, y 45–55); target has only the three dots and the white bar (y≈70) there.

Accepted as version 5: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 5 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
"yours" is closer to the target than "previous": the stray white square artifact at the card's top-left (1.96–2.36s) is gone, the 0.80–1.56s dark panel now reaches the target's size, and the late row stack is no longer over-filled. CHANGE: better

1. Header bar geometry — 1.96–2.76s — "yours" white bar is left-shifted and thicker (x≈55–180, y≈112–124); target keeps a centered thin bar at x≈95–215, y≈115–122.
2. Row reveal timing — 2.36–2.76s — "yours" already shows a green row/dot (x≈70–90, y≈158) while the target still has only red (x≈70–105) and blue (x≈70–130) rows; green should first appear at 3.16s.
3. Late stack extent — 3.96–5.92s — "yours" rows stop ~10px short on the right (end x≈180 vs target x≈205) and the 4th–5th rows sit ~6px high, so the target's fuller, evenly spaced stack isn't matched.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 6: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 6 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer than previous — the 0.40s placeholder and the 0.80s card are both larger and nearer the target's size, though the entrance is still late and undersized. CHANGE: better

1. Card/placeholder entrance, 0.00–0.80s: yours is blank at 0.00s and its gray placeholder at 0.40s spans ≈x26–180, y26–215; the target already shows a faint full-size card at 0.00s and its placeholder fills ≈x25–195, y25–230.
2. Card build, 0.80–1.20s: yours still draws the gray header and navy body as two separate rounded rects with a white gap (header ≈x25–150 y20–95, body ≈x25–190 y100–240); the target is one full-width card (≈x20–235) with the gray header flush against its top edge.
3. Content lines, 1.96–2.76s: yours' white title line is only a short stub (≈x25–85, y≈100) at 1.96s and the cyan bar is a ~5px sliver at 2.36s; the target's line is already full width (≈x55–200) by 1.96s and both red and cyan bars reach full length by 2.76s.

Accepted as version 7: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 7 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer to the target than previous: the white bar now reaches full width at 1.96s and the 0.40s gray ghost is the right size, but the colored bar stack still builds up too late. CHANGE: better

1. Colored bar stack — 3.16–4.36s: yours shows only 3–4 bars (green ~y148 and teal ~y168 rows missing) while the target already has 5–6 by 3.16–3.56s; yours only catches up around 4.36s.
2. White bar onset — 1.56s: yours already draws a short white segment (~x68–80, y≈128); the target panel stays blank and the bar first appears at 1.96s.
3. Dark panel entrance — 0.80–1.20s: yours' panel is smaller and sits low-left (roughly x60–195, y55–195); the target panel is already near full size and centered (~x50–205, y45–200) by 1.20s.

Accepted as version 8: 14 layer(s).
Automatic full review 1 (an independent reviewer compared filmstrips and motion curves of the target and your version 8):
Comparing the fine frames (1.00–2.00 s) plus the two filmstrips and the motion curves, the visible differences that matter, most important first:

1. **Panel (big dark-navy rounded rect, ≈x 20–236, y 20–236)** — *fade-in timing/easing wrong.* Target: canvas is pure white at 0.12 s and 0.24 s, first faint grey only at ≈0.30–0.36 s, mid-grey 0.52–0.64 s, fully dark navy by ≈0.76–0.88 s (a late, fast fade). Yours: already a faint grey rect at 0.12 s and 0.24 s, still light at 0.52 s, only mid-grey at 0.64 s and 0.76 s, reaching navy ≈0.88–1.00 s. So yours starts ~0.2 s too early and darkens too gradually (should be delayed then snap darker).

2. **Coloured text bars (blue / red / teal / green, inside the panel, y≈85–210)** — *yours runs ~0.12–0.24 s ahead.* At 2.28 s target shows only the white heading + a short red bar, while yours already shows red **and** blue; by 2.88 s target has ~5 bars and yours ~7. Same at 2.40–2.76 s (yours is consistently one frame richer). Motion chart confirms: yours' (thin black) blue/teal/red visible-size curves start rising ~0.2–0.3 s before target's thick curves. Target staggers each new bar later than yours does.

3. **White heading bar (panel, y≈58–68, growing rightward from x≈40)** — *appears/grows too late and too slowly in yours.* Target: first white mark at ≈1.68 s, ~half length at 1.84 s, full length (to x≈150) by ≈1.92 s. Yours: nothing until ≈1.78–1.80 s, still a short stub at 1.88 s, only full length at ≈2.00 s. At the same 1.88 s frame target's bar is roughly twice as long as yours'.

4. **Three dots (panel top-left, ≈x 36/48/60, y≈34)** — *wrong stagger.* Target fades them in one by one, well spaced: 1st ≈1.18–1.20 s, 2nd ≈1.44 s, 3rd ≈1.66 s. Yours: 1st ≈1.30 s, 2nd ≈1.48 s, 3rd ≈1.60 s — the first dot is ~0.12 s late and the whole sequence is compressed/too fast.

5. **Teal bar final size** — *yours' is too big.* In the motion chart (teal row) target's teal visible size plateaus at ≈0.50 of the panel height, yours' (thin black) at ≈0.62; target's teal bar stays noticeably shorter/smaller than yours at the end.

6. **Blue bar position/motion** — *target slides, yours pops in place.* Motion chart (blue row): target's blue centre x dips (moves left) around ≈2.2 s and its y steps down/up before settling, whereas yours' blue line is flat in both x and y from the moment it appears — i.e. yours appears statically where target animates it into position.
The reviewer still sees clear differences.

Accepted as version 9: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 9 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
"yours" is slightly further from the target than "previous": the fade-in, the white bar and the stacked colored bars all match, but the 3-dot counter no longer builds up. CHANGE: worse

1. Dot counter, 1.20–1.56 s: "yours" card stays empty; target shows 1 dot at 1.20 s then 2 dots at 1.56 s (x≈52–85, y≈52–64) before all three appear at 1.96 s.
2. Dot pop-in, 1.96 s: with the 1-dot and 2-dot frames gone, "yours" jumps straight from 0 to 3 dots at once instead of staggering 1→2→3.
3. Green bar row, 3.16–3.56 s: target places a green bar on the same row as cyan, directly under the left red bar (x≈55–110, y≈135–150); "yours" puts that green one row lower.
4. Stack depth, 3.96 s: target already shows a right-side red bar (x≈125–190, y≈150–162) that "yours" is still missing.

Accepted as version 10: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 10 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is about the same as previous — the two rows match cell-for-cell almost everywhere, so nothing visibly regressed and nothing clearly improved; the same gaps against the target remain. CHANGE: same

1. Dark card fade-in — 0.40–1.20 s: target's card (x 64–190, y 8–92) is already a faint gray panel at 0.40 s and only mid-navy at 0.80 s, reaching full opacity ~1.2 s; yours is blank at 0.40 s and jumps to full dark by 0.80 s (onset ~0.3 s late, ramp too steep).
2. Green accent — 2.36–2.76 s: target stays white-bar + red-bar only at 2.36 s and first shows green at 2.76 s (bar plus tiny tick at x≈8, y≈84); yours shows the green tick at the card's bottom-left (x≈6–14, y≈82–88) already at 2.36 s, ~0.4 s early.
3. Stacked text rows — 3.16–5.92 s: target builds white / red / blue / green with the extra green row arriving at ~4.4 s and bar ends near x≈160; yours has the red/green/blue rows one step ahead (extra row by ~3.96 s) and the lower bars end ~10 px shorter, so the stack reads ahead of the target through the second half.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 11: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 11 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):

Accepted as version 12: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 12 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to the target than previous: the card's entrance now reads as a mid-gray square at 0.80 s instead of popping in fully dark, and the bar stack reaches the target's 6-bar count by ~5.9 s. CHANGE: better

1. Top-left dots — 1.56–1.96 s: yours (x≈66–84, y≈56–66) is bare; target already shows two small gray dots from 1.56 s (three by 2.36 s), yours only starts them at 2.36 s.
2. Stray clipped bar stub — 2.76–3.16 s: yours draws a short bar flush against the card's left edge (x≈60–80, y≈146–158; teal at 2.76 s, red at 3.16 s) that the target never has there — the target's 5th bar first appears at 3.56 s and begins at the same left inset as the others.
3. Card fade-in start — 0.00–0.40 s: yours already shows a clearly visible light-gray card (x≈60–200, y≈50–210) at 0.40 s, while the target is still essentially white at 0.40 s and only reaches ~50% gray at 0.80 s.

Accepted as version 13: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 13 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
Yours is essentially the same as previous — the two share the same structure and stray artifacts, so neither meaningfully closes the gap on the target. CHANGE: same

1. Stray green element, 2.76s: yours (and previous) show a tiny green speck at x≈65–80, y≈172 that the target does not have at all; target stays white-bar/red-bar/blue-bar until 3.16s.
2. Green bar too small, 3.16s: yours renders the green row as a speck near x≈70, y≈175, while the target draws a full green bar spanning x≈75–155 at y≈168.
3. Colored-row order/length, 3.56–5.92s: yours keeps blue in the 3rd slot and lets bars run out to x≈190; the target's 3rd slot is teal with shorter bars ending near x≈175, giving a looser 4-row stack instead of yours' 5 tight rows.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 14: 14 layer(s).
Automatic full review 2 (an independent reviewer compared filmstrips and motion curves of the target and your version 14):
Comparing the filmstrips and the motion curves, the clearest mismatches are:

1. **Dark tile reveal / background card — 0.36–1.00 s (whole canvas, tile x≈18–238, y≈18–238).** Target first grows a pale light‑grey rounded square (visible from ~0.36 s, covering most of the tile by 0.64 s), then the dark navy tile scales up on top of it from ~0.72 s and is fully dark navy by ~0.88 s. Yours shows nothing at 0.36–0.64 s, and at 0.76–0.88 s your tile is still mid‑grey (roughly the size the target's dark tile already is); it only becomes dark navy around 0.95–1.00 s. So the pale pre‑reveal card is missing and the dark fill is ~0.2 s late.

2. **Cyan bar (right of the red bar, y≈160) is too long too early — ~2.5–3.5 s.** Target's cyan starts as a dot at ~2.34 s at the red bar's right end, is only ~20–25 px long at 2.6 s and grows in small visible steps (roughly 2.6 s, 2.75–2.85 s, 3.5 s) reaching its full ~45 px (right edge x≈167) only near 3.5 s. Yours ramps smoothly and is already ~30–45 px at 2.6–2.9 s, i.e. 10–20 px too long through ~2.6–3.4 s.

3. **Teal/green bar (bottom‑left, y≈185) too long too early — ~2.9–4.2 s.** Target keeps it a tiny dot at ~2.9 s and grows it in steps, only reaching its final length (~55 px, right edge x≈178) around 3.6–4.3 s. Yours is already ~10–15 px longer at 3.04–3.5 s and hits final length ~3.3 s, so it is oversized for most of 3.0–4.2 s (the target thick teal curve sits below yours until ~4.3 s).

4. **Second red bar at the right (x≈205–230, y≈160) — ~3.6–4.3 s.** Target brings it in at ~3.6 s and it reaches full length quickly; in yours it appears at about the same moment but is ~5–8 px shorter and only reaches the target length around 4.3 s.

5. **Red bar start (left, y≈160) — 2.1–2.5 s.** Both start as a dot at ~2.08 s, but yours reaches full length slightly sooner (full by ~2.28 s vs target ~2.32–2.36 s) and its left end sits ~3–5 px further left (x≈62 vs ≈68 in target) for the rest of the clip.

6. **White bar length (y≈118) — 1.9–5.9 s.** Yours is consistently ~8–10 px longer at the left end (e.g. at 5.9 s left edge x≈98 vs ≈108 in target); at 1.76 s your white stub is also a little wider. The right end matches.

7. **Tile settling — 1.0–1.6 s.** Target's navy tile size and x/y settle cleanly by ~1.0 s; your navy visible‑size and x/y curves stay jagged until ~1.6 s (the tile keeps scaling/jittering after it is already fully dark), and your tile centre sits ~1–2 px lower than the target's for the rest of the clip.

Timings that do match: the three grey dots (1.24 s / 1.52 s / 1.76 s), white bar appearance (1.76 s), red bar appearance (2.08 s), cyan dot (2.34 s), teal dot (~2.9 s), overall end state at 5.92 s.
The reviewer still sees clear differences.

Accepted as version 15: 14 layer(s).
Quick check of version 15 by the reviewer (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to target than previous: the 0.40s card fade-in and the top-left three-dot indicator from 3.16s onward now match, but the dots are still missing 0.80–2.76s and a stray green mark lingers at 2.76s. CHANGE: better

1. Dots indicator, 0.80–2.76s: yours shows a plain dark card; target already shows three dots at the card's top-left (≈x76–98, y74–82) from the card's very first frame, so the "typing" state reads late in yours.
2. Stray green mark, ~2.76s: yours has a small green speck at the card's lower-left (≈x78, y150); target has no green there — its green bar only starts around 3.9s at y≈152.
3. Red/teal bar growth, 2.36–3.16s: target's red bar reaches ≈x150 and its teal bar ≈x180 by 3.16s; in yours both bars sit roughly 20–30 px shorter at the same times, so the second and third bars lag the target's growth curve.
Finished.
